row.body: A fuel can is paired with a route slip for a field visit; the return line says “full” though the can is nearly empty.
row.title: Fuel before the run

sidecar.gloss: A field route ends with a fuel record that conflicts with the container.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency run could use the same fuel and route; the inconsistent return line does not identify the trip.

row.body: Repair note: flush the field sprayer at the wrench mark before returning it. The pump seal had softened and the mechanic wrote that the rinse water stung his hands.
row.title: Wrench stop after the sprayer run

sidecar.gloss: Wrench stop after the sprayer run
sidecar.rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

row.body: Cash receipt: fuel at the marked stop, charged to the late-season crop trial. The driver added that the tank was full before the detour and nearly dry afterward.

row.body: Notebook line under “you’ll need it”: reserve another can for the second pasture pass. The first crew came home coughing before any emergency convoy used the road.
